description:
Cast Involuntary Employment by paying {3}{R}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Involuntary Employment targeting the creature.
Resolve the copy of Involuntary Employment, untapping the creature and creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Dual Casting
uses.cardState: attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness
